meta.scope: Dimensionless downward inside-quality displacement with outside quality fixed. Nominal external enforcement, physical cap, original absolute target and price orbit stay fixed. Four uncertainty levels are illustrative bounds, not empirically calibrated confidence intervals. Duplicate slots/repeated calibrations are not independent evidence. No unknown enforcement, uncertain mu, non-logit demand, incentive stability or general controller optimum is covered.
meta.apiCallScope: Experimental seller/model API calls; Codex development assistance is separately disclosed.
meta.provenance: Compact rows regenerated read-only and byte-matched against the raw-evidence-gated descriptive analysis; source/current audit and completion independently checked. No finite-game model is changed.
